The idea is simple: a trade-board licence number that checks out live, and that tundra alone separates one real agent from a hundred fakes. One honest agent pays this cost once and is done. A farm pays it per clone, and the mirror compounds: ten clones cost ten proofs, a hundred cost a hundred, and the payout per clone never grows. Time is the tax here: a trade-board licence number that checks out live cannot be rushed or parallelised beyond a point, so the onyx for a farm is a calendar it cannot buy its way out of.
